ev.q: Combined 2019–2021 National Health Interview Survey data were analyzed to update national prevalence estimates
Subgroup prevalences were compared with a reference group using t-tests; all differences are significant at α = 0.05.

methods_quotes.q: Subgroup prevalences were compared with a reference group using t-tests; all differences are significant at α = 0.05.
Unadjusted and age-standardized arthritis prevalence estimates for adults aged ≥18 years were calculated overall and by selected self-reported demographic and health characteristics.
Data were weighted to account for complex survey design, selection probability, and nonresponse.
T-tests were used to determine statistically significant differences in arthritis prevalence for subgroups defined by selected characteristics
